context: Gantt chart with edge-bundled dependency chains for a 50-task, 4-phase project timeline (Discovery, Design, Development, Launch), with hover interaction that traces full upstream/downstream dependency chains in pink highlight.
first_impression: Clean diagonal cascade of phase-colored bars with barely-visible dependency threads — restrained and scannable at a glance.
what_works: The 4-color Tol palette maps exactly to 4 phases with strong perceptual separation; dependency complexity is hidden by default (0.25 opacity) and revealed only on hover, keeping the resting state uncluttered. Phase background bands and left-margin labels efficiently chunk 50 tasks into 4 cognitive groups.
what_doesnt: At 50 tasks the row height shrinks to ~10px, making individual bars thin enough that precise date-reading becomes difficult without hovering; the 9px task label font is borderline readable and would fail at any viewport narrower than 1200px.
